sources.snippet: Zipf's law (/ zɪf /) is an empirical law stating that when a set of measured values is sorted in decreasing order, the value of the n -th entry is often approximately inversely proportional to n. sources.snippet: ABSTRACT This work proves that ranks and shares are statistically dependent on one another, based on simple combinatorics. It presents a formula for rank-share distribution and illustrates that Zipf's law, is descended from expected values of various ranks in the new distribution.
